avatar.title: Avatars and manifestations
avatar.intro: How one being appears as, or is understood through, another. Texts and traditions use different words for this, and KĀLA keeps them apart.

avatar_of.name: Avatar
avatar_of.definition: A descent of a deity into the world for a purpose, as the texts describe it (often called an incarnation in English).

manifestation_of.name: Manifestation
manifestation_of.definition: A form in which a deity appears or acts, without the idea of a descent into a birth.

aspect_of.name: Aspect
aspect_of.definition: One side or power of a deity, sometimes personified as a separate figure.

identified_with.name: Identification
identified_with.definition: A text or tradition says that two names refer to the same being.

avatar.listsIntro: Different texts give different lists, in different orders. Each list is shown as that text gives it.
avatar.compareIntro: A dash means the list does not include that figure. Highlighted rows are not in every list.
avatar.formsIntro: These are not entries of an ordered list. Each kind of relationship is shown separately and carries its own source.

philosophy.title: Philosophy
philosophy.intro: Ideas such as dharma, karma, moksha, atman and Brahman, and how different schools of thought understand them.
philosophy.differNote: The schools do not always agree. Each concept page shows every view side by side, with its own texts. Buddhist and Jain understandings are distinct and will be added in a later phase.
philosophy.schoolsIntro: Each school’s explanation of a concept rests on its own texts.

pilgrimage.title: Pilgrimage and sacred geography
pilgrimage.intro: The great circuits of pilgrimage and their sacred places, each tradition in its own place.
pilgrimage.respectNote: These are living places of worship. Lists differ between texts and traditions, and each is shown as its source gives it.
